<function name="SelectAll" parent="Panel" type="classfunc">
	<description>Selects all items within a panel or object. For text-based objects, selects all text.

<note>Only works on <page>RichText</page> and <page>TextEntry</page> and their derived panels by default (such as <page>DTextEntry</page>), and on any panel that manually reimplemented this method.</note>
</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
</function>
